mapper.select: select configured_flag, case when configured_flag = '1' then provider_name else '未配置' end provider_name, account_alias, credential_mask, case when configured_flag = '1' then account_status else 'UNCONFIGURED' end account_status, available_balance, warning_threshold, retry_enabled, last_success_time, last_error from wo_sms_account_setting where id = 1

select coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' and sent_at >= current_date() and sent_at < date_add(current_date(), interval 1 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) todaySent, coalesce(sum(case when status in ('RETRY','DEAD') and update_time >= current_date() and update_time < date_add(current_date(), interval 1 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) todayFailed, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' and sent_at >= date_format(current_date(), '%Y-%m-01') and sent_at < date_add(last_day(current_date()), interval 1 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) monthSent from wo_notification_task where channel = 'SMS'
mapper.update: update wo_sms_account_setting set warning_threshold = #{warningThreshold}, retry_enabled = #{retryEnabled}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = 1
